name: Private food-draft mutation transport parser and request-policy boundary
phase: Specification only; implementation requires separate explicit authorization
objective: Parse bounded private mutation submissions only after authorization, preserving canonical domain semantics and fresh authorization for every subsequent service operation.
scope: Framework-neutral; expose only createInitialRecipe, appendRecipeRevision, createInitialProduct and appendProductRevision. Reuse FOOD-001A-I and D2 unchanged.

requestEnvelope.expectedOrigin: Trusted server configuration only, never submitted fields, forwarded headers or body data. Require a canonical HTTP(S) serialized origin.

executionOrder: Request method/origin/content-type/header policy rejects before gate or body access.
Invoke FoodPrivateDraftOperationGate.runAuthorized with a zero-argument lazy callback.
Only inside the authorized callback read bounded body bytes, decode form, parse bounded duplicate-aware JSON, validate through FOOD-001A and invoke FOOD-001I mutation.
Denied authorization invokes reader and parser zero times. No duplicated administrator/principal checks, cached decision or authorization token.

The callback result remains opaque to D2. Explicitly unwrap the outer gate result: preserve access code/message or callback-failed; on gate success return the nested transport/controller result without reclassifying it as authorization.
Every eventual mutation reaches normal FOOD-001D and freshly authorizes again. Product exact-recipe lookup also authorizes independently; revocation between any stages is honored.

wireFormat.parameters: Only optional charset=UTF-8. Media-type and charset tokens are case-insensitive under HTTP token semantics; reject other parameters or duplicate charset parameters.
wireFormat.predecessor: Required for both revision operations and forbidden for both initial-create operations.
wireFormat.fieldPolicy: Reject missing required, repeated singleton, unexpected and non-string/file-like fields. Snapshot is one complete JSON object, not indexed fields or checkbox-derived domain values.

limits.counting: Limits are inclusive. Root JSON object has container depth 1. Count every object, array and scalar value once; property names count toward string limits but not value count. Decoded JSON string limit covers both property names and string values.
limits.contentLength: If supplied, require canonical nonnegative decimal 0 or [1-9][0-9]*, safe integer and at most encodedBodyBytes. Reject signs, whitespace, leading zeros, fractions, exponents and unsafe forms before body read. Malformed header is invalid-request; over-limit declared length is payload-too-large. A smaller declaration never proves actual bounds.
limits.streaming: Enforce actual consumed bytes independently of Content-Length. Stop immediately on overflow, perform iterator return/cleanup where supported, and do not continue draining. Overflow remains payload-too-large even if cleanup throws. Accept only Uint8Array chunks; malformed chunks are invalid-request. Invoke the lazy reader once and never retry.

formDecoding: Strict UTF-8 decoding of body and percent-encoded fields; reject invalid UTF-8, malformed percent escapes and malformed field encoding.
Use standard URL-encoded plus-to-space decoding; this wire decoding is not domain normalization.
Reject empty or malformed field segments, repeated decoded names, unknown names and missing fields. Preserve values without trimming, case folding, Unicode normalization, defaults or repairs.
snapshotJson: Implement a bounded JSON parser/tokenizer; ordinary JSON.parse alone or a reviver cannot detect keys lost through overwrite.
Detect duplicate decoded property names at every object level before constructing the object. For example id and its escaped-equivalent name are duplicates.
Reject decoded property names __proto__, constructor and prototype at every level as the deterministic prototype-hazard rule; do not assign potentially dangerous properties to ordinary prototypes.
Reject invalid grammar, trailing content, non-object root and all depth/string/array/node/byte violations. JSON whitespace is permitted by grammar and does not trim domain values.
Preserve all array order exactly. Record numeric token spelling so every domain version field can be checked lexically before conversion.
canonicalVersions: Every JSON version field, including evidence subjects, recipe references and historical label reference, must use positive decimal integer tokens [1-9][0-9]* and pass validateFoodVersion.
Form expectedPreviousVersion matches [1-9][0-9]* within its text limit and passes FOOD-001A validation after numeric conversion.
Reject zero, leading zeros, whitespace-changing values, signs, fractions, exponent notation and unsafe integers. Never normalize or generate versions.
domainAuthority: Use FOOD-001A validators/constants, not copied or reinterpreted domain rules. Domain validation failures use fixed invalid-input; transport/form/JSON syntax failures use invalid-request.
Preserve canonical food IDs, exact case-sensitive enums, real canonical dates, evidence subject/type/ID/version and source/reference/reviewer/issuer attribution.
Preserve ingredient order, one level of purchased-component subingredients, allergen order and existing duplicate declaration/evidence rules.
Preserve omission separately from explicit unknown or undisclosed; exact historical recipe references and optional historical label references remain unchanged.

Never invent, normalize, repair or retarget domain values. Completeness is not approval, safety, allergen-free status or sale authority. B/C retain initial/consecutive/current-latest, immutable history and retry/conflict authority.
productValidation: After authorized transport parsing, extract and canonically validate the exact recipe ID/version from the product reference using FOOD-001A before lookup.
Read that exact recipe through the injected FOOD-001I controller. Do not expose a transport read operation, bypass FOOD-001D or substitute latest.
Not-found exact recipe maps to fixed invalid-input. Preserve existing lookup access, invalid-input and storage failure codes with fixed workspace feedback.
Validate product only against the successfully retrieved exact recipe using FOOD-001A. Never fabricate a validation recipe.

Product mutation still invokes FOOD-001I/FOOD-001D and authorizes again. Typical product success involves gate authorization, separately authorized recipe lookup and separately authorized mutation. Repository independently enforces the exact stored recipe reference.
requestPolicy: Require one valid HTTP(S) Origin in canonical serialized form exactly equal to trusted expectedOrigin.
Reject missing Origin, literal null, malformed/opaque/multiple origins, credentials, paths, queries, fragments, unsupported schemes and cross-origin values before gate/body access.
No Referer fallback and no expected-origin inference from arbitrary Host or Forwarded headers. Policy failures never masquerade as authentication failures.
csrf: No separate session-bound CSRF token in J. This depends on the later route preserving POST-only behavior, mandatory fail-closed exact Origin verification, trusted expected origin and authenticated FOOD-001D authorization.
Session authentication alone is insufficient. Weakening Origin enforcement requires a separate CSRF design review; idempotency does not replace CSRF protection.
retry: No persisted submission token or new idempotency key. Preserve B/C identical identity/version/canonical content retries as already-present and differing same-key content as conflict.
After uncertainty preserve exact identity, version, canonical content and predecessor. Never automatically retry, increment/generate versions, merge payloads or change predecessor.

resultModel.success: Preserve FOOD-001I mutation result shape and created | already-present | conflict distinctions.

transportMessages.origin-rejected: Private food request origin is not permitted.
transportMessages.unsupported-content-type: Private food request content type is not supported.
transportMessages.payload-too-large: Private food request exceeds the permitted limits.
transportMessages.invalid-request: The private food request is invalid.
transportMessages.body-unavailable: Private food request body could not be read.

resultModel.gateMessages: Preserve exact existing D2 access messages and callback-failed message Private food operation could not be completed.
resultModel.serviceMessages: Preserve existing fixed FOOD-001I workspace feedback for controller failures and invalid-input domain failures; do not reuse untrusted result messages.
resultModel.bodyFailures: Reader invocation/iteration throw or rejection maps to body-unavailable. Invalid form/JSON maps to invalid-request. Any defined payload limit violation maps to payload-too-large. Unexpected callback exceptions remain D2 callback-failed.
resultModel.sanitization: Failure results retain no submitted snapshot, private evidence, parser excerpt, malformed field contents, exception/stack, SQL/D1 details or internal conflict reasons. No submitted payload echo or failure form-state retention.

construction: Synchronous and I/O-free. Invoke no gate, controller, reader, parser, service, repository or database during construction.
tests: All four operations and exact identity/version/predecessor/reference forwarding.
Method, origin and content-type rejection before gate/body access; malformed/oversized Content-Length rejected before body access.
Denied gate causes zero body reads/parsing; callback result opacity and explicit outer unwrapping.
Revocation between stages, second fresh mutation authorization and independent product-read authorization.
Repeated/missing/unexpected fields, malformed percent encoding and invalid UTF-8.
Encoded/decoded byte, depth, string, array and value-count boundaries; overflow immediately stops consumption and closes iterator where possible.
Duplicate JSON keys including escaped equivalents, prototype-like names, invalid grammar, trailing content and non-object roots.
Canonical numeric lexical edge cases across all version fields and predecessor; malformed Content-Length variants.
Omission versus unknown/undisclosed, ingredient/subingredient/allergen/evidence order and existing domain constraints.
Exact product recipe read, not-found invalid-input, access/storage lookup failures and no latest substitution or fabricated recipe.
Identical/historical retries, conflict and uncertain storage without automatic retry/version generation.
All fixed transport/service/gate feedback, body throw/rejection distinction and no private payload retention.

No destructive or sale-authority operations, zero construction I/O and source isolation from Astro/routes/UI/runtime/global acquisition/config/migrations/commerce/payment/deployment/unrelated systems.

authorityBoundaries.FOOD-001D/D2: Fresh authorization and opaque callback gate

deferredScope: Actual Astro routes/actions/pages/components, navigation, HTTP status mapping, redirects and safe form-value retention.
Runtime exposure of D2 gate through E/F/G; no type assertion or alternate authorization bypass to acquire it.
RIVER_FOOD_DB provisioning/configuration, migrations, administrator configuration and runtime activation.
Public products, commerce/checkout/Stripe, fulfillment/accounting/community, deployment, production data and unrelated systems.
currentTaskBoundary: Create only this specification; no implementation or existing-file changes, staging, commit, runtime configuration, D1 access, migration or deployment.
nextStep: Review the specification before separately authorizing the two-file implementation.
